summary: Provisional-credit applied to decommissioned subaccount during org-region migration causing finalized invoice mismatch
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a finalized invoice with a missing provisional credit. During a scheduled org-region migration (us-east -> us-west), several subaccounts were decommissioned and reattached. CurioAI sees a $4,872 charge on invoice INV-2026-03-07 where a provisional credit for reserved-hours should have been applied. Impact: unexpected invoice increase, finance escalation, potential service interruption if unpaid. Related context: customer uses Dedicated Reserved + Hosted fallback; they recently migrated primary billing region and ran batch embedding jobs during the migration window.
timeline: 2026-03-11 22:00 UTC - CurioAI began org-region migration (billing region switch).
2026-03-12 01:15 UTC - Large batch embed job submitted by subaccount 'curio-research-03' (5M tokens).
2026-03-12 01:20 UTC - Orchestration process decommissioned subaccount and reattached under new org mapping.
2026-03-12 02:00 UTC - Billing postback for the job sent; provisional credit initially calculated and assigned to subaccount id XYZ-03.
2026-03-12 04:30 UTC - Postback reconciler replayed historical events during migration; duplicate reprocessing flagged and one provisional credit reversed to 'decommissioned-subaccount'.
2026-03-12 08:00 UTC - Invoice INV-2026-03-07 finalized without the provisional credit applied to CurioAI parent org.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create subaccount and run a large batch embedding job using embedder-v2.1 in us-west-2.
2) Trigger a simulated org-region migration/mapping update that decommissions and reattaches subaccounts during job/postback window.
3) Allow postback-reconciler to process both initial and replayed events (simulate duplicate postback).
4) Finalize invoice for the billing period and inspect provisional credit allocation and invoice lines.
observed_behavior: Provisional credit for reserved-hours was calculated but marked as 'applied_to: decommissioned-subaccount' during reconciliation.
Finalized invoice shows the charge with no offsetting provisional credit line on the parent org.
Audit trail shows credit created (credit id CR-90822) but later reversed with reason 'orphaned-account-finalizer'.
expected_behavior: Provisional credit should be reparented to the active parent org if the originating subaccount is decommissioned within reconciliation window.
Finalized invoice should include provisional credit line or a holding credit balance applied to the customer ledger.

customer_message: CurioAI (finance lead - Maya Park) 2026-03-12 10:03 UTC: 'We were expecting the provisional reserved-hours credit to offset the embedding job. Invoice shows full charge and our accounting team flagged this as a variance. Please escalate and advise next steps.'
investigation_notes: Initial triage: reproducible race between org-service decommission and postback processing leading to credit assigned to a subaccount state that no longer had an active parent pointer.
Hypothesis: reconciler's orphan-detection rule marks credits as non-transferable if decommission timestamp < credit applied timestamp; migration caused timestamp inversion.
Checked reconciler code: orphaning threshold default 2h; migration replay logic reprocessed historical events and triggered orphaning flow when mapping changed after initial credit creation.
Found related job: MAP-774 (org mapping update) executed 2026-03-12T01:20Z; reconciler replay occurred 2026-03-12T04:30Z and considered subaccount state=decommissioned leading to reverse_credit path.
No previous automated rollback or manual adjustment performed for INV-2026-03-07.
temporary_workaround: Manually create and apply an invoice-level adjustment credit (CR-EMERG-223456) to CurioAI ledger for $4,872 to cover the missing provisional credit.
Hold autopay for INV-2026-03-07 until adjustment is confirmed to avoid collection action.
resolution_plan: 1) Apply manual ledger credit CR-EMERG-223456 to CurioAI and mark invoice as adjusted. 2) Patch postback-reconciler to reparent credits for decommissioned subaccounts when a valid parent mapping exists within a configurable time window (PR attached). 3) Backfill: run reconciler script to identify other credits reversed with reason 'orphaned-account-finalizer' during MAP-774 window and re-evaluate reparenting. 4) Postmortem and customer communication. Target fixes deployed to prod by 2026-03-18.
resolution: In progress: manual ledger credit applied on 2026-03-13; awaiting internal patch and backfill verification. Customer notified and autopay held.
